headline: Federal judge orders White House to restore access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico
caption:
🇪🇸 Un juez federal ordenó el 24 de septiembre restaurar el acceso a la Casa Blanca para periodistas de CNN, MS NOW y Politico mientras continúa su demanda contra la prohibición anunciada por el presidente Donald Trump. El juez Timothy Kelly determinó de forma preliminar que la medida probablemente violaba protecciones constitucionales.

🇺🇸 A federal judge on September 24 ordered White House access restored for journalists from CNN, MS NOW and Politico while their lawsuit challenging President Donald Trump's ban continues. Judge Timothy Kelly preliminarily found the restriction was likely unconstitutional.

Sources: Reuters / AP — Sept. 24, 2026.
